brief:
The Guardian editorial board has cautioned against the Green Party's approach to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, arguing that rejecting a two-state solution offers no clear path to peace. The piece comes as party co-leader Zack Polanski navigates criticism over the party's Palestine policy, facing pressure to defend Palestinian freedom while maintaining support among Jewish members and demonstrating the party's capacity to manage internal disagreements.

Last year, the UN General Assembly endorsed the New York Declaration backing a two-state solution in the Holy Land with 142 votes in favor and 10 against. The editorial suggests that departing from this international consensus requires careful justification rather than serving as a shortcut to resolving the conflict.
dek: Zack Polanski must defend Palestinian freedom while reassuring Jewish members and showing that his party can handle disagreements Last year, the UN general assembly endorsed the New York Declaration supporting two states in the Holy Land by 142 votes to 10.
title: Guardian editorial questions Green Party Palestine stance on two states
